mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.enterprise_id, s.signal_type, s.title, s.detail, s.source_name, s.source_url, s.observed_at, s.expires_at, s.strength, s.confidence, s.source_record_id, s.created_at, r.published_at, r.fetched_at, CASE WHEN r.validity_status = 'VALID' AND s.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND s.expires_at < NOW() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE r.validity_status END AS validity_status, r.raw_payload, CASE WHEN COALESCE(LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.raw_payload, '$.demo'))), 'false') NOT IN ('false', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_demo FROM ent_company_signal s LEFT JOIN collector_record r ON r.id = s.source_record_id AND r.enterprise_id = s.enterprise_id WHERE s.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} ORDER BY s.observed_at DESC, s.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ent_company_signal (enterprise_id, signal_type, title, detail, source_name, source_url, observed_at, strength) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{signalType}, #{title}, #{detail}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceUrl}, #{observedAt}, #{strength})
